components.css: .ds-version{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(12rem,.85fr) minmax(0,1.35fr) auto;align-items:center;gap:1.5rem;padding:1.5rem 1rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font:400 1rem/1.55 "Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif;color:var(--ink)}.ds-version[data-selected=true]{background:var(--selected);outline:1px solid #ad8d17;outline-offset:-1px;border-radius:4px}.ds-playback{min-width:0}.ds-version-button{font:700 1rem/1.4 "Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif;min-height:2.75rem;padding:.65rem 1rem;border:1px solid #aaa09e;border-radius:4px;color:var(--ink);background:var(--surface);cursor:pointer}.ds-playback .ds-version-button{width:100%}.ds-version-button:hover:not(:disabled){background:#faeeed;border-color:var(--accent)}.ds-version-button:focus-visible,.ds-playback audio:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #634a00;outline-offset:4px}.ds-version-button:disabled{opacity:.6;cursor:not-allowed}.ds-playback audio{display:block;width:100%;min-width:0;height:2.6rem;margin-top:.65rem}.ds-version-description h3{margin:0 0 .5rem;font-size:1.25rem;line-height:1.2;overflow-wrap:anywhere;text-wrap:balance}.ds-version-description p{margin:.35rem 0;font-size:.85rem;max-width:72ch}.ds-version-muted,.ds-version-state{color:var(--muted)}.ds-version-description .ds-version-state{font-size:.8rem}@media(max-width:75rem){.ds-version{grid-template-columns:minmax(11rem,.8fr) minmax(0,1fr)}.ds-version>.ds-version-button{grid-column:2;justify-self:start}}@media(max-width:48rem){.ds-version{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);padding:1.25rem;gap:1rem}.ds-version-description{grid-row:1}.ds-version>.ds-version-button{grid-column:1;justify-self:stretch}.ds-playback{width:100%}}

components.css: .ds-estimate{width:min(100% - 2rem,35rem);max-height:calc(100dvh - 2rem);overflow:auto;padding:0;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;color:var(--ink);background:var(--paper);box-shadow:0 1.5rem 5rem rgb(0 0 0 / 25%);font:400 1rem/1.55 "Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif}.ds-estimate::backdrop{background:rgb(34 43 53 / 65%)}.ds-estimate-content{padding:clamp(1.5rem,4vw,2.5rem)}.ds-estimate h2{margin:0 0 .75rem;font-size:1.65rem;line-height:1.2;letter-spacing:-.025em;overflow-wrap:anywhere;text-wrap:balance}.ds-estimate p{max-width:72ch}.ds-estimate-lyric{margin-block:1.25rem;padding:1rem;border:1px solid #ad8d17;border-radius:4px;background:var(--selected)}.ds-estimate-lyric p{margin:0;font-size:.95rem}.ds-estimate-lyric .ds-estimate-text{margin-top:.65rem;white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.ds-estimate-muted{color:var(--muted)}.ds-estimate-actions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.65rem;margin-top:1rem}.ds-estimate button{font:700 1rem/1.4 "Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif;min-height:2.75rem;padding:.65rem 1rem;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer}.ds-estimate .ds-estimate-cancel{color:var(--ink);background:var(--surface);border-color:#aaa09e}.ds-estimate-confirm{color:var(--surface);background:var(--accent)}.ds-estimate .ds-estimate-cancel:hover:not(:disabled){background:#faeeed;border-color:var(--accent)}.ds-estimate-confirm:hover:not(:disabled){background:var(--accent-strong)}.ds-estimate button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #634a00;outline-offset:4px}.ds-estimate button:disabled{opacity:.6;cursor:not-allowed}

narrative.overview:
A red advertiser navigation shell frames white paper work areas and dark ink.
The interface is precise, restrained, and familiar to ad sellers. Color supplies
orientation; a workhorse sans-serif carries the working content without spectacle.

Controls retain native expectations, compact proportions, thin rules, and small
corners. Selected lyrics and their audio source receive the yellow emphasis.
Listening, paid confirmation, and human review remain distinct, legible actions.
keyCharacteristics: Red advertiser shell and paper work areas
Dark ink and approved workhorse sans-serif typography
Yellow emphasis for selected lyrics and linked audio
Flat sections, thin rules, and small control corners
Native controls and explicit human approval safeguards

rules.name: The Selection Has Meaning Rule
rules.body:
Reserve yellow emphasis for selected lyrics,
linked audio, and source context, not decoration or general success.

rules.name: The Working Type Rule
rules.body:
Keep the approved sans-serif for display and controls;
use size, weight, and spacing rather than an ornamental display face.

rules.name: The Flat Work Area Rule
rules.body:
Keep working sections flat; reserve lifted depth for
the confirmation dialog.

dos: Do use the red advertiser shell, paper work areas, and dark working text.
Do preserve native inputs, audio controls, disclosure, and modal behavior.
Do pair selection color with explicit state text and accessible control state.
Do show the exact lyric option, hook, and full text before paid confirmation.
Do preserve permissions, paid consent, held drafts, provenance, and human approval.
Do respect reduced motion and retain visible keyboard focus.
donts: Don't use yellow as decoration or as a substitute for approval.
Don't add raised shadows to ordinary work sections.
Don't replace the approved workhorse type with an ornamental display face.
Don't turn generated, screened, or playable status into broadcast approval.
Don't treat the sidecar's illustrative tonal ramps as additional shipped colors.
